dict.string: omacchiato-bar sends commands to Music for the media pill, and asks Ghostty to reload its colours after a theme change.
omacchiato-bar shows how many bluetooth devices are connected in the status bar.
omacchiato-bar lists what is left of today in the clock popup. It reads your events and never changes them.
macOS treats the name of the wi-fi network you are on as location data. omacchiato-bar shows that name in the status bar; it never reads your position.
